components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string

## Summary

The spec: an owner response must carry `bulkSignupWarning: true` once **more than 80** owners have already been created on today's business day, else `false`.

### Changes

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `bulkSignupWarning` boolean to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field/getter/setter.

2. **`OwnersCreatedToday.java`** (new) — extracted the "count owners registered on today's business day" logic that was previously inline in `EnsureDailyOwnerLimit`. This is now the single home for that count, reused by both the per-day limit and the new warning. It relies on the existing `BusinessDay` weekend roll-forward, keeping both rules bucketing by the same adjusted day.

3. **`EnsureDailyOwnerLimit.java`** — refactored to call `OwnersCreatedToday.count(...)` instead of duplicating the loop, so its responsibility is just the limit decision.

4. **`BulkSignupWarning.java`** (new) — the single definition of the warning threshold (`> 80`) and decision, delegating the count to `OwnersCreatedToday`.

5. **Responders** (`RespondWithOwner`, `RespondWithOwnerCreated`, `RespondWithOwnerUpdated`) — each now sets `dto.setBulkSignupWarning(BulkSignupWarning.isRaised(ownerRepository))` when building the response DTO, so every full owner response (GET/POST/PUT) carries an accurate, response-time value.

### Design notes
- The warning depends on live repository state, not on a single owner, so it belongs at response-construction time (the responders) rather than in the pure `OwnerMapper`, which stays a per-owner transform.
- Counting logic lives in one small class reused by both the limit and warning rules — no copy-paste, each class keeps a single responsibility.

The acceptance test (`GET` after a fresh create asserts `bulkSignupWarning == false`) and the full suite pass with `BUILD SUCCESS`.
